description: Create a kitchen decluttering inventory spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/kitchen_declutter.xlsx. The template has headers and 2 example items. Add at least 13 more kitchen items (15+ total) with: Item Name, Last Used, Condition (Excellent/Good/Fair/Poor), Category (Cooking/Baking/Serving/Storage/Appliance), Decision (KEEP/DONATE/SELL), Estimated Sell Value (for SELL items), and Reason. Ensure: 4+ KEEP, 6+ DONATE, 3+ SELL items, and 2+ items per category. Below the data, add calculations: Total Potential Revenue (SUM of sell values), Items to Remove (COUNTIF DONATE + COUNTIF SELL), Retention Rate (% KEEP). Format: bold/colored header row, color-code decisions (KEEP=green, DONATE=blue, SELL=orange/red), currency format for sell values, percentage for retention rate. Save (Ctrl+S).
